reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates pass: Gate 1 — GET is an exported Next.js route handler (public API exception, caller-count irrelevant); Gate 2 — attack vector is an untrusted Discord OAuth user via public PKCE callback (no trust_assumptions entry applies); Gate 3 — src/app/auth/ is explicitly in scope and Discord membership bypass is a listed key concern. An attacker (expelled Discord user with a valid member.members DB record) can trigger this via Discord OAuth by completing the PKCE flow at /auth/callback (membership check commented out at route.ts:105-119), then accessing /dashboard during any STEM Bot API degradation or env-var misconfiguration, causing checkDiscordMembership (actions.ts:1256-1258) to return {success:false, isInServer:false}, which causes the layout-level guard condition (layout.tsx:129-133) to evaluate false and silently grant full dashboard access. Severity remains High; no client-diversity cap applies.
